Comment: PETadex DIAMOND sharded search: fan out one worker per shard (Map), then aggregate. Fail-fast: any shard failure aborts the whole job. ${WorkerFunctionArn} and ${AggregatorFunctionArn} are substituted at deploy time.

BuildErrorSignal.Comment: Fail path: build the negative-signal payload the poller reads. References ONLY always-present execution-input fields (sessionId/jobId) plus the caught $.error, so it can never fail on a missing field — unlike RecordFailureTiming, whose Parameters read version/submittedAt/orchestratorTiming and silently no-op'd on the throttle abort (Plan §10.6). $.error.Error distinguishes throttle vs OOM vs timeout downstream.

RecordSessionError.Comment: Negative signal: native S3 PutObject (NO Lambda) to results/{sessionId}.error so the backend poller reports status:failed well before the client timeout, instead of spinning. Keyed on sessionId (the only path the poller knows) — never jobId. Native S3 (not a Lambda writer) so it survives the throttle storm that would also throttle any Lambda. Runs BEFORE RecordFailureTiming so the sentinel is written even if the timing rollup fails; either way the job still ends as JobFailed (a Fail state), keeping CloudWatch/alarms honest. Requires s3:PutObject on results/* in the state-machine role. Body is the $.errorSignal object passed DIRECTLY (not States.JsonToString, which double-encodes the body into a quoted JSON string) so the .error file is clean single-encoded JSON — verified live 2026-07-07.

RecordFailureTiming.Comment: Fail-fast path: the normal Aggregate never ran, so invoke the aggregator in timing-only mode to roll up whatever per-shard sidecars exist into a failed timing.json, then still fail the job. Preceded by a Catch with ResultPath $.error, so the top-level fields (sessionId/jobId/version/submittedAt/shards) survive for the Parameters below.

JobFailed.Cause: One or more shard workers (or the aggregator) failed; job aborted (fail-fast, see Scale-Out Plan Phase 5).
